info.title: API.SH: Sitejabber
info.description: The Sitejabber API from API.SH: public Sitejabber data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

A business's Sitejabber profile: name, website, logo, summary, categories, rating, review count and star distribution, per-aspect ratings (service, value, shipping, returns, quality), how reviews were collected, verified-review stats, its ratings on other review platforms, yearly trend, response rate, popular terms, questions, similar businesses and the first page of reviews.

get.description:
A business's reviews on Sitejabber, newest first: title, text, tip, stars, aspect ratings, published and experience dates, verification, votes, views, photos, videos, products used, shipping facts, the business's reply and the reviewer's country (never their name or username). Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page. Sort with `sort` (newest, oldest, highest, lowest, helpful, relevant) and narrow with `rating`, `keyword`, `timeframe`, `verified`, `has_photo` and `english`; `total` and `last_page` then count the matching reviews (20 a page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sitejabber-reviews

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The business's website (e.g. zappos.com) or its sitejabber.com/reviews/<domain> link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based); `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Review order: newest or oldest first, highest or lowest rating first, most helpful votes first, or the site's relevance order. Default: the business page's own order (newest first).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with these stars: 1-5, or several separated by commas (e.g. `1,2`).

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Only reviews mentioning this word or phrase (100 characters at most).

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Only reviews published in the last 7, 30, 180 or 365 days.

parameters.name: has_photo
parameters.description: true: only reviews with photos or videos.

parameters.name: english
parameters.description: true: only reviews written in English.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
